scripts.format: clang-format -i -style="{Language: JavaScript, BasedOnStyle: Google, ColumnLimit: 80}" src/*.ts test/*.ts
scripts.prepare: npm run copy-protos && npm run generate-types && npm run generate-test-types && npm run compile
scripts.pretest: npm run generate-types && npm run generate-test-types && npm run compile
scripts.generate-types: proto-loader-gen-types --keepCase --longs String --enums String --defaults --oneofs --includeComments --includeDirs proto/ --include-dirs proto/ proto/xds/ proto/protoc-gen-validate/ -O src/generated/ --grpcLib ../index channelz.proto xds/service/orca/v3/orca.proto
scripts.generate-test-types: proto-loader-gen-types --keepCase --longs String --enums String --defaults --oneofs --includeComments --include-dirs test/fixtures/ -O test/generated/ --grpcLib ../../src/index test_service.proto echo_service.proto

manifest.description: gRPC Library for Node - pure JS implementation
